summary: Recommends simulating nested loops by shaping data, e.g. using product to give multiple users access to multiple databases.
questions: How do I do a nested loop in Ansible?
How do I loop over every combination of two lists?

answer_card.title: Nested loops with product
answer_card.answer_md:
Shape the data instead of nesting loops:

```yaml
- community.mysql.mysql_user:
    name: "{{ item[0] }}"
    priv: "{{ item[1] }}.*:ALL"
    append_privs: true
    password: "foo"
  loop: "{{ ['alice', 'bob'] | product(['clientdb', 'employeedb', 'providerdb']) | list }}"
```
